task.description:
Fix the two issues found by CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR in src/design/AGT-01-04-agent-artifacts.md:

1. CDV-AGT-01-04-001 (MAJOR, E050): The 'API Response Shapes' fenced Zig code block (~line 273) is too long (>40 lines). Split it into multiple shorter blocks, one per logical group (e.g. artifact response shapes, task spec response shapes, schema catalog shapes), each with its own prose heading.

2. CDV-AGT-01-04-002 (MINOR): In Data Flow step [5], change '≤' to '<' for the attempt_count regression guard (submitted < stored max, not ≤).

Do not change anything else in the design.
